message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV and immediately maps columns without any schema checks, dtype assertions, null checks, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: The data is loaded from a local file path ('insurance.csv') with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used before or during training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation only performs categorical encoding and a train/test split; no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples is performed.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains and saves a model using pickle without any hash check, signature verification, or integrity validation; no pretrained model is loaded, and the saved model has no integrity protection applied.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks the distribution, range, or anomalies of the target variable 'charges' before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger scanning, or any other backdoor-defense mechanism in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, etc.) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: The code only trains and saves the model; there is no inference serving path, and no input validation or sanitization is performed on incoming requests.
No detected output bounds checks: No output bounds or NaN checks are applied to model predictions; only evaluation metrics (MAE, MSE, RMSE) are computed during training.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular regression model (RandomForestRegressor), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
